actionsPage.title: Follow-up

scenarios.title: Scenarios
scenarios.desc: Save snapshots of the whole model, load them back, and compare outcomes side by side. Scenarios are stored in this browser.
scenarios.saveHead: Save current numbers as a scenario
scenarios.emptyHint: Adjust the model on the other pages, then save it here under a name. Loading a snapshot replaces every input with the saved values.
scenarios.backupHead: Move the whole model between devices
scenarios.backupDesc: The backup file contains your current inputs, daily reports, and saved scenarios as JSON.
scenarios.importFailed: Import failed: not a valid VEGA backup file.
scenarios.loadedMessage: Loaded "{{name}}" into the model. Review costs before relying on it.
scenarios.legacyNote: Legacy v1 file — upgraded automatically on import; recovery entries and actions were not stored in v1.
scenarios.keptInputsNote: Merge keeps your current model inputs — choose Replace to adopt the backup's inputs instead.
scenarios.previewStats: Merge plan: {{added}} will be added · {{updated}} updated · {{conflicts}} conflicts stay local (newest wins).
scenarios.droppedWarning: Some records in this file were corrupt and will be skipped — Replace is disabled to protect your history; Merge keeps every valid row.
scenarios.mergeDoneMessage: Merged into current data. Model inputs were kept — use Replace on a lossless backup to adopt them.
scenarios.replaceDoneMessage: All data replaced from the backup dated {{date}}.
scenarios.partialFailMessage: Restore finished in memory but NOT fully saved: {{keys}} failed to write. Free up storage and re-run the restore.
scenarios.legacyScopeBtn: Restore legacy scope (model, days, scenarios only)
scenarios.scopedDoneMessage: Legacy scope restored: model input plus {{days}} recorded day(s). Recovery entries and actions were preserved.
scenarios.rollbackCriticalMessage: CRITICAL: the restore failed AND could not fully roll back. Affected keys: {{keys}}. Export a fresh backup before closing this page.
scenarios.corruptLegacyWarning: This legacy file contains corrupt rows — scoped restore is blocked so corruption cannot overwrite your current data. Use Merge instead: only valid rows will be adopted.

report.narrativeTargetGap: {{short}} shipments short of plan ({{percent}}% below target).

report.insightVisitsLogged: {{visits}} customer visits logged — keep the commercial pipeline moving.

providerImport.warn_conflict_delivered: Two different توصيل values appear — the first was kept; fix the source text if wrong.

import.title: Paste or upload stops
import.desc: CSV or tab-separated rows. Nothing is written until you confirm the preview.
import.errTooLarge: Too many rows or too large — split the file.
import.errMissingHeaders: Could not find customer and stop columns in the header row.

stops.dupProbableAck: This may duplicate an existing stop. Review it, then tick the acknowledgement to save anyway.
stops.dupProbableAckLabel: I reviewed the possible duplicate — save anyway.
stops.import.errReadFailed: The file could not be read — try again or paste the rows instead.
